Combining responsible AI with human creativity
Realizing the benefits of AI while mitigating the risks requires a combination of responsible AI principles and humans-in-the-loop (HITL). As a trusted AI expert, we combine our data science and machine learning capabilities with deep industry knowledge and technology engineering skills to generate new insights, experiences and business models powered by AI.

Advancing responsible innovation in the age of GenAI and agentic AI
Generative AI has brought about a paradigm shift from automation to creation. This brings a new wave of opportunities for organizations and consumers alike. We help clients tap the potential of this powerful technology responsibly.
What is generative AI?
We provide best practices for developing guardrails, policies and AI governance. Our models for AI operations (AIOps) address issues of ethical AI, trust, transparency, explainability, fairness, non-bias, data/model/provenance, privacy, security, AI regulations, intellectual property and more.
What is responsible AI?
Agentic AI takes us beyond static automation. It plans, reprioritizes and executes using a mix of tools, models and memory. At CGI, we help clients design agentic ecosystems with built-in guardrails, transparency and feedback loops. The results are more predictable, resilient and responsible systems.
What is agentic AI?
